notes: Both are real structural redesigns: waiting-room rail, status as text, visible double booking, alerts on top, tabs kept for temps. B's legend strip with counts over the grid and its prominent search are strong. A's panel follows the actual check-in sequence better, and its grid cells read more cleanly.
